findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_places" stacks urgency/override words (always, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "compute_routes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Public sink: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Destructive: search_places, lookup_weather, compute_routes, resolve_names.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Public sink: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Destructive: search_places, lookup_weather, compute_routes, resolve_names

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compute_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
